question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**pondering**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The protagonist is reflecting on and considering the significance of the discovery of the gravestone.
 
• '**Pondering**' (विचार करते हुए) fits the context of thinking deeply about the situation.
 
• Therefore, the most appropriate word to complete the sentence is: Pondering.
